units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 18:5">Ex. R. s. 18</cite> <he>הנקבות הב׳</he> the first-born females (in Egypt).
<cite ref="Bava Batra 123a:13">B. Bath. 123ᵃ</cite> <he>נטל ב׳ מראובן וכ׳</he> took the birth-right from Reuben and gave it to Joseph.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 123a:13">Ib.</cite> <he>ראויה היתה ב׳ וכ׳</he> the first birth (of Jacob’s children) was destined to issue from Rachel.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 124a:5">Ib. 124ᵃ</cite> <he>חלק ב׳</he> the share of the first-born; a. fr.

senses.gloss: the law appertaining to first-born animals, v. בְּכוֹר.—
units: Bekh. I, 1 חייב בב׳ is subject to the law &c., פטור מן הב׳ is exempt from &c.; a. v. fr.—Pl. בְּכוֹרוֹת, v. supra a. בְּכוֹר.—B’khoroth (Bekh.), name of a Talmudic treatise, belonging to the order of Kodashim (קדשים).
